title: MUtE: A Dual Framework for Concept Erasure and Counterfactual Interventions

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using concept probing accuracy on word embeddings (GloVe) and biography representations (Bias in Bios), downstream fairness metrics (Demographic Parity and True Positive Rate Gap RMS) on occupation classification, and gender substitution success rates in counterfactual text generation.

Evaluated via concept probing accuracy and downstream fairness metrics (Demographic Parity and True Positive Rate Gap RMS) for sentiment classification models operating across different linguistic dialects, specifically African-American English (AAE) versus Standard American English (SAE) in the DIAL dataset.

Measured using concept probing accuracy to evaluate the erasure of five distinct religious identities (Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, and Muslim) from text embeddings in a toxicity classification task using the Jigsaw dataset.
